# Actions continue-on-error Check

> A free, read-only command-line tool that scans GitHub Actions workflow files for jobs and steps with a literal `continue-on-error: true`, the places where a failure can still leave the run green. Zero dependencies (Python standard library), no network calls, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). It flags a pattern for a person to decide on; it is not a judgment that any use is wrong, not a security audit and not a YAML parser. A clean scan means this one pattern was not found. Expressions such as `continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}` are trusted and not flagged. It does not see `|| true` inside `run:` scripts.

## What it reports

- `job-continue-on-error`: a job that can fail while the workflow run stays green, so a required status check on that job can never go red.
- `step-continue-on-error`: a step whose failure is swallowed while the job carries on.

## Use

- `python3 check.py` scans `.github/workflows` under the current directory.
- `python3 check.py /path/to/repo` scans a checkout; `python3 check.py ci.yml` scans one file.
- `--format json` for machine-readable output; `--fail-on-risk` exits 2 when any finding exists.

There is no browser page yet.

## Source

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/actions-continue-on-error-check): MIT licensed.
